column1: JASSO Scholarship Pamphlet 2025-2026 — Sortable Master List

Source: Japan Student Services Organization (JASSO) Scholarship for International Students in Japan 2025-2026. Use the filter dropdowns on each column to narrow by country, field, age limit, etc. Sections: III = Local Govts, IV = Private Foundations, V = For applicants residing abroad. Sub-entries under one foundation use suffix numbering (e.g., 61-1, 61-2). Qualifier codes: HS=High School, CT=College of Technology, ST=Specialized Training, UJ=Univ Japanese Program, JL=Japanese Lang Institute, JC=Junior College, A=Auditors (Undergrad), U=Undergrad, R=Research Student, P=Professional Degree, M=Master's, D=Doctoral. Selection: D=Document, I=Interview, W=Written exam, O=Others.
